## Type of change

<!-- Select the primary type of change. This determines the semantic version bump. -->

- [ ] `feat` — new feature (minor version bump)
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix (patch version bump)
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement (patch version bump)
- [ ] `refactor` — code refactor (no version bump)
- [ ] `chore` / `docs` / `build` / `ci` / `test` / `style` (no version bump)
- [ ] `BREAKING CHANGE` — backward-incompatible change (major version bump)

## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit-style PR title (`feat:`, `fix:`, etc.)
- [ ] Branch follows `feature/*`, `fix/*`, `hotfix/*`, or `release/*`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm format:check` passes
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes (unit tests)
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes
- [ ] E2E smoke tests pass (CI)
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry added if user-facing (unless a release PR)
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes
